title: [Bug] can't embed files to knowledge base
body:
### 📦 Environment

Docker

### 📌 Version

1.46.3

### 💻 Operating System

macOS

### 🌐 Browser

Firefox

### 🐛 Bug Description

By default, lobechat uses OpenAI for embedding.

We do have a local AI running on a mac mini, with ollama. It works fine for chatting. But when we try another embedding model thru ollama (we pulled paraphrase-multilingual:latest), lobechat still thinks it should go thru OpenAI

on docker-compose .env file, we added:
`DEFAULT_FILES_CONFIG=embedding_model=ollama/paraphrase-multilingual:latest`

We're kinda lost on the chinese tutorials, but we know you need to add `"provider"/` before embedding model itself

But when we stop and run again, lobechat still tries to route thru openAI. here's the log:
`Route: [openai] InvalidProviderAPIKey: { error: undefined, errorType: 'InvalidProviderAPIKey' }`

Is there a way to embed files locally on lobechat? And if yes, can you point us to a tutorial? And if no, then it's def a bug.

Aside the cost, we don't want to use non-local options out of principle.
